title: Additivity of verification work cost
statement: For all natural numbers $n$ and $r$, the cost with zero random-example calls, zero queries, and $r$ units of work, added to the cost with zero calls, zero queries, and the verification's local work at dimension $n$, equals the verification cost for parameters $n$ and $r$.
